answer: Because the ledge burn is written down at the pigment settlement, the tundra audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 59% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. Honest users pay that once, farms 19 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
